- Pure JavaScript, Node.js runtime, ES Modules ONLY: `import` / `export`. `require()` and `module.exports` are forbidden.

from whoosh.fields import Schema, TEXT, ID
from whoosh.index import create_in
from whoosh.qparser import QueryParser
from whoosh.query import Every

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--a', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--b', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--c', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

schema = Schema(title=TEXT(stored=True), content=TEXT)
temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ix = create_in(temp_dir, schema)
writer = ix.writer()
writer.add_document(title=args.a, content=args.b)
writer.add_document(title=args.b, content=args.c)

- `/output/lib/fields.mjs` exports:
  - `class FieldType` — `constructor(options = {})`; sets `this.stored = Boolean(options.stored)`.
  - `class TEXT extends FieldType` and `class ID extends FieldType` (no extra behavior needed).
  - `class Schema` — `constructor(fields = {})`; stores the given object (field name -> FieldType instance) as `this.fields`.

- `/output/lib/query.mjs` exports:
  - `class Query` — base class; method `matches(doc)` returns `false`.
  - `class Every extends Query` — `matches(doc)` returns `true` for any doc.

- `/output/lib/qparser.mjs` exports:
  - `class QueryParser` — `constructor(fieldname, schema)`; stores both as properties. Provide a minimal `parse(text)` method that returns an `Every` instance (import `Every` from `./query.mjs`). The entry script imports this class but never calls it, so keep it minimal and correct.

- `/output/lib/index.mjs` exports:
  - `class Index` — holds `dirname`, `schema`, and committed documents in memory on the instance; `.writer()` returns an `IndexWriter` bound to this index; `.searcher()` returns an `IndexSearcher` bound to this index.
  - `class IndexWriter` — `.addDocument(fields)` where `fields` is a plain object (field name -> string); queues the document; `.commit()` makes queued documents visible to searchers.
  - `class IndexSearcher` — `.search(query)` returns an array of the committed document objects for which `query.matches(doc)` is `true`. `results.length` is the count the entry script prints.
  - `function createIn(dirname, schema)` — returns a new `Index`. (This mirrors whoosh's `create_in`.)
  - In-memory storage per Index instance is sufficient; no real on-disk index format is needed. Only Node built-ins may be imported, and only if actually needed.

    - `constructor(options = {})`: `options.prog` optional; if omitted, default to the basename of `process.argv[1]` (use `node:path`).

    - Token forms: `--name value` and `--name=value` (empty value via `--name=` is valid). If the same option appears twice, the last occurrence wins. A value token that starts with `-` (and is not exactly `-`) counts as an option-like token, NOT as a value.

      ```
      usage: PROG [-h] --a A --b B --c C

      options:
        -h, --help  show this help message and exit
        --a A
        --b B
        --c C
      ```
